name: Smart Money Concepts [LuxAlgo]
description: Advanced strategy focusing on market structure (BOS, CHoCH), Order Blocks (OB), and Fair Value Gaps (FVG).

indicators.structure: Tracks Swing Highs/Lows to detect BOS and CHoCH

long: Bullish CHoCH detected (trend reversal to upside)
Price retraces into a Bullish Order Block or fills a Bullish FVG
Body closes above the OB/FVG zone
short: Bearish CHoCH detected (trend reversal to downside)
Price retraces into a Bearish Order Block or fills a Bearish FVG
Body closes below the OB/FVG zone

exit_rules: Take Profit at the next major Swing Point or opposing Order Block
Stop Loss below the Order Block that triggered the entry
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1% of portfolio per trade
